title.narrative: Responding to South Sudan Hunger and Sudan Crisis

description.narrative: The project will achieve its objective through Emergency Food Security Livelihood (EFSL), Water Sanitation and Hygiene (WASH), Gender and Protection interventions as detailed in the Response Strategy. Activities will be implemented through a mix of direct implementation and working with local partners. The Project will be implemented in Upper Nile (Renk), Jonglei (Akobo East, West, Walgak and lankien) and Greater Pibor Administrative Area. This project target approximately 240,000 vulnerable refugees, returnee and IDPs in South Sudan
